column7: A storage read fault in the secondary reads of the secret-access-request pre-check (shares, schedule), in GetSecretAccessRequest (request lookup, caller authority) and in AcknowledgeAnomalyAlert was answered as a uniform 404 "not found", so an outage looked like "this secret/request/alert does not exist" and hid whether the caller was allowed; the by-reference scope gate did the same for ?ref= lookups. Each now answers 503 storage_unavailable (core.ErrStorageReadUnavailable via SecretReadVerdictFault / classifyReadError) while a true not-found and a refusal keep their 404. A non-holder of the scope permission still gets the same 403 as for an absent ref (TestScopeResolverRefReadFault). Red on origin/main: see the session report.
